_readme: Every number we guessed rather than measured. Edit the values, not the key names. What each one means, and when to change it, is the settings table in docs/reference/architecture.md. See config/README.md before your first edit.
_otp_max_per_hour: Codes sent an hour, across everybody. Guards the SMS bill: the per-number cooldown does nothing against a caller that changes the number every time, and every code sent is money. Raise it if a real cohort ever hits it.
